meta.note: Cave-campaign authoring scaffold: one gameplay-invisible horizontal platform, one entry door, and one sequential exit door.

entities.text:
"I was never a very good wizard.
Spells & incantations wasnt for me."

"But the insides of a rocket engine...
That's where the real magic happens!"

entities.thoughtText:
That is an interresting bridge.
What a lovely sense of minimalism!

entities.text:
"I asked the workers that they were doing. 
One yelled 'Splash World Aquaslide!' 
and threw his tools at me."

"The first thing of note I saw was 
the ancient aqueduct. A true wonder! 
Workmen were striking it with hammers."

"As I didnt understand the language
I assumed it was some conservation project. 
How lovely to see old relics being saved!"
